description.fun: A little smith that pounds scraps of iron into a hammer, then remakes it again and again until it's satisfied. It swings the hammer to protect itself, but Pokémon that eat metal keep stealing it. It can tell good scrap metal from bad, and groups of Tinkatink learn their metalworking from a Tinkaton leader.
description.guide: A Fairy and Steel-type Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, designed by Megumi Mizutani. Tinkatink is female-only and forges its own hammer from scrap metal. It evolves into Tinkatuff and then Tinkaton.
description.tagline: A tiny blacksmith forever forging its hammer

description.fun: Tinkatuff ambushes groups of Pawniard and Bisharp to collect metal for a large, sturdy hammer, and it raids factories and warehouses in human towns for more. It lives in piles of scrap metal, and two Tinkatuff test their hammers' strength by smashing them together. The hammer doubles as its pillow.
description.guide: The middle stage of Tinkatink's line, a Fairy and Steel-type Pokémon that builds a bigger hammer from metal it collects.
description.tagline: A scrap-heap smith that raids Bisharp for metal

description.fun: A small, pink, reckless genius with a hammer that weighs over 100 kg, bigger than its own body, which it swings with ease. It knocks rocks into the sky trying to hit flying Corviknight, which is why Paldea's flying taxis use Squawkabilly instead. It steals whatever it pleases and carries the loot home, then naps on its hammer.
description.guide: The final evolution of Tinkatink, a female-only Fairy and Steel-type Pokémon that swings a gigantic hammer. A Tinkaton leads each group of Tinkatink and teaches them metalworking.
description.tagline: A tiny smith with a giant hammer, aimed at Corviknight
